text.suptitle: Banked-map shift cosine: real vs spectrum-matched random map, unpatched vs patched
fig_texts:
Bars = mean over every row; points = per-row values (random arms pool all 20 rotation draws, subsampled to 600 for legibility — the bar still uses every value).
For the UNPATCHED arms the 'shift' is each context's deviation from its setting-cell floor mean. cos = 0 is the no-alignment line and is exactly where direction R² = −1 sits.
